name: Manatsu no Oozora no Shita de
source:
Summer, 1983 (Showa 58)

The playzone on the roof was our place of yearning.
It was a little rusty, and the games were old.
We loved it dearly. Under the blue summer sky, that's where I met the girl. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE158989.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
1983年夏（昭和58年）。

屋顶上的游乐区是我们向往的地方。

那里有些生锈，游戏机也很老旧。

我们深爱着它。在蓝色的夏日天空下，我在那里遇见了那个女孩。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE158989.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
